deliver.next_transition: The task is done when its pull request merges on green CI after one reviewer pass; the task and the pull request are its record.

configure.next_transition: process_policy.py and the model settings must validate the exact changed configuration before it is committed.

setup.next_transition: Complete the setup preflight and selected scaffold checks before presenting the configured project.

organize_docs.next_transition: The vault checker must validate each authorized write and the final selected vault structure.

issue_report.next_transition: Return the external issue-report result from conversation evidence; no project transition is authorized.

repair_policy: Open findings, the new delta and affected consumers; widen when impact is uncertain. Never drop mandatory review passes.
barrier: Wait for all readers to finish or confirm cancellation before the named owner writes canonical sources.

output_contract.findings: Stable IDs, severity, source anchor, impact, repair and verification condition.
output_contract.self_check: Required inputs, mode, ownership and output elements present or missing.
output_contract.context_findings: Observed missing, wrong, stale or excessive context and recurring retrieval friction; expected behavior, source anchors, impact, recovery/result, proposed fix and verification case when known. Return to the parent; no direct filing. Parent uses issue-report with anonymous content and explicit user approval, or routes project-only gaps to the document owner.
